description: Cross-league model training-data ledger for the SportsDataverse ecosystem. One entry per model: what it was trained on, the full available data range, why the subset, and known provenance gaps. Companion to dev/model-training-data-audit-2026-07-28.md. Types: trained_artifact (persisted booster/coefs shipped or released), fitted_constants (scalars baked into source), compute_on_demand (fit per call; `artifact` is null when nothing persists, or references run outputs / unpublished builds / borrowed dependencies rather than a shipped artifact), empirical_table (distribution/table, not a model), port (deterministic port, no training). `trained_seasons` / `holdout_seasons` are inclusive [start, end] windows; `holdout_seasons` records the held-out gate/calibration window when one exists.
